subject.title: fix(polls): reject polls with fewer than two options

question: Should the exported `resolvePollMaxSelections` helper establish throwing on zero- and one-option polls as its public invalid-input contract before it reaches a release?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically small, but the durable plugin SDK contract—returning a numeric value versus throwing for invalid input—requires maintainer ownership rather than an automated choice.

options.title: Adopt the rejecting SDK contract
options.body: Accept the established minimum-two-options invariant at the shared helper boundary and merge the PR before this helper is released.

options.title: Keep a non-throwing helper contract
options.body: Preserve a numeric-result contract for invalid inputs and define a different boundary for validation before merging any follow-up.

recommendation.title: Adopt the rejecting SDK contract
recommendation.body: Accept the established minimum-two-options invariant at the shared helper boundary and merge the PR before this helper is released.
